blind.description: A low, circular mound of assorted skeletal remains, including three human skulls, a ribcage positioned near the top center, and numerous crossed long bones (femurs/arm bones) clustered together. The models are stylized and cleanly sculpted, tightly fused together into a single cohesive pile with a flat underside sitting directly on the ground. The material is a uniform matte warm beige/light tan bone color with subtle shading.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a roughly circular disc or cluster of bones, prominently featuring a central ribcage flanked by rounded skulls on the upper left and right and long bones laid crisscrossed across the lower half.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely low, reaching only about ankle height (around 6 to 8 inches tall), with a diameter roughly 1.5 to 2 feet across (about one-third the height of the figure).
